races.title: State House, District 109
races.note: Unopposed: this seat was decided without a general-election contest, so it won't be on your ballot.

cands.name: James Bush III
cands.bio: Retired Miami teacher. Democrat who held Florida House District 109 in 1992-2000, 2008-2010 and 2018-2022. Lost the 2022 and 2024 primaries to Ashley Gantt. Unopposed in 2026.
cands.local_ties: Miami Northwestern Senior High graduate (1974); long-time Miami teacher (Wikipedia, BallotReady).

record.text: House District 109 in 1992-2000, 2008-2010 and 2018-2022; unsuccessful 2000 run for Commissioner of Education and 2010 run for U.S. House (FL-17) against Frederica Wilson.
Wikipedia says he supported bills backed by Gov. Ron DeSantis, including the 'Don't Say Gay' bill, and that this drew criticism from some Democrats.

cands.gaps: 2026 donors, endorsements and campaign website not found. Photo is from his earlier House term. Owner-source search NOT run (shared web-search budget exhausted).
